$comment: Fixed category vocabulary consumed by schema/theme.schema.json and schema/external.schema.json (the 'categories' enum in both must match the ids below). Themes are categorised by layout/target — what kind of listings the theme is built to present — which is a different axis than the plugin registry's function-based categories. Add an entry only for a category a real theme would claim.

categories.label: General
categories.description: Broad-purpose layout suited to any classifieds vertical, not built around one listing type.

categories.label: Marketplace
categories.description: Multi-vendor / storefront layouts — seller profiles, product-style grids, shop pages.

categories.label: Real Estate
categories.description: Property listing layouts — galleries, maps, floor plans, and structured specs.

categories.label: Jobs
categories.description: Job-board layouts — company profiles, salary and employment-type fields, application flow.

categories.label: Vehicles
categories.description: Auto/vehicle listing layouts — spec tables, comparison views, mileage and condition fields.

categories.label: Directory
categories.description: Business or service directory layouts — profile pages over classified listing pages.

categories.label: Minimal
categories.description: Stripped-down, typography-first layout with few decorative components.

categories.label: Magazine
categories.description: Editorial layout blending listings with articles, featured content, and a homepage grid.

categories.label: Mobile-first
categories.description: Designed primarily for small viewports, with the desktop layout as the adaptation.

categories.label: RTL
categories.description: First-class right-to-left layout support beyond CSS logical-property patching.

categories.label: Accessibility
categories.description: Built or audited for WCAG conformance — contrast, keyboard navigation, screen-reader structure.
